lines.text: Moses recites a song to all Israel, asks his teaching to fall like rain and dew, and calls the LORD the Rock.
The LORD found Jacob in a howling wilderness and guarded him like an eagle that spread its wings over its young.
Jeshurun grew fat and abandoned God, and they sacrificed to angels, gods they had not known.
One man could chase a thousand only if the LORD had given them up, and their vine came from Sodom and Admah.
God says there is no God besides Him, and the song ends by calling the nations to rejoice with His people.
